/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/arklib-v4.31.0/ArkLib/ProofSystem/Binius/BinaryBasefold/Prelude.lean').read_text()
a=src.index('theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly'); b=src.index('/-- Given a point "'`v'"',a)
d=src[a:b].rstrip()
p=d.index('  have h_fiber_diff :')
q=d.index('  set P_i_plus_1 :=',p)
proof='''  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have h₀ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by omega) y (0 : Fin 2)
    have h₁ := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by omega) y (1 : Fin 2)
    simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin2ToF2, ↓reduceIte] at h₀ h₁
    change x₀ = _ at h₀
    change x₁ = _ at h₁
    rw [h₁, h₀]
    simp [normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1 𝔽q β]
'''
d=d[:p]+proof+d[q:]
Path('candidate.lean').write_text(d+'\\n')
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
